name: Jael
overview: The Scripture presents Jael, the wife of Heber the Kenite, as a pivotal figure in God's deliverance of Israel by slaying Sisera, the enemy general. When Sisera fled to her tent seeking refuge, Jael welcomed him, gave him milk to drink, and concealed him under a covering. Yet, as he lay weary and asleep, she courageously took a tent peg and hammered it through his temple, killing him and thus securing victory for Israel. This account highlights God's use of unexpected instruments, like Jael, to accomplish His purposes and protect His people.
